note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: # owner signs in: pac auth create --environment $env:MG_DEV_URL --deviceCode
Read-Host 'Owner: if the tenant has a data policy, Contoso Holidays (or https://date.nager.at*) is in the same group as Dataverse; episodes 1-3 are in DEV. Press Enter'

screens.name: connector-definition
commands: pac connector create --api-definition-file apiDefinition.swagger.json --api-properties-file apiProperties.json --script-file script.csx --solution-unique-name EquipmentDesk
steps: After the terminal part: Solutions > Equipment Desk > Contoso Holidays > Edit
Definition tab: three actions, Get days off selected
Code tab: custom code enabled for GetDaysOff only
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
connector id (GUID) printed by pac connector create/list, in the terminal

screens.name: connector-test
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk > Contoso Holidays > Edit > Test tab
Operation GetDaysOff: Country PT, From Year 2026, Subdivision PT-30 > Test operation
Scroll the response: status 200, count 15, 2026-07-01 Madeira Day (PT-30), the excluded Carnival and Azores Day
Repeat with Country XX: 404 with 'The holiday source returned 404 for XX 2026: ...'
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
the connection name if it contains a user name

screens.name: app-monitor
steps: Data pane: Contoso Holidays next to Equipment and Loans
App > Formulas: show DaysOff and Holidays
Advanced tools > Monitor, then play the Open loans screen
Show one GetDaysOff row (fromYear 2025, toYear 2027, status 200)
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: flow-dropdown
steps: Add an action > Custom > Contoso Holidays > Get days off
Open the Country drop-down: country names are listed
Expand advanced options to show Subdivision; no 'List countries' action is offered
Do not save: discard the flow
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: the connector and the app change stay for episode 6; make sure the unsaved test flow is discarded (My flows must not list it).'
